تعترفوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَرِفُوا (taʕtarifū) /taʕ.ta.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# تُعْتَرَفُوا (tuʕtarafū) /tuʕ.ta.ra.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
